Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment used iTRAQ for multiplexed quantification of protein expression profiles. While LMD (Laser Microdissection) was used for sample capture, this is a sample preparation step rather than a biochemical PTM enrichment. The authors explicitly stated that phosphorylation was not investigated in this study.

scope: To exclude stromal cells, cancer cells were captured by LMD using a light microscope (DM 6000B; Leica Microsystems, Wetzlar, Germany) and transferred into a tube cap

For protein extraction, samples were incubated in 98 μl of 9.8 M urea, 1 μl of phosphatase inhibitor cocktail (Nacalai Tesque, Kyoto, Japan), 1 μl of protease inhibitor cocktail (Nacalai Tesque) and 0.5 μl of benzonase (Calbiochem, San Diego, CA, USA) for 30 min at room temperature.
The tumor cells were recovered by laser microdissection.

Ontology_SampleSourceAndScope_prompt.notes: The material analyzed by MS consisted of total protein extracts from laser-capture microdissected (LMD) tumor cells and cell lines. No specific subcellular fractionation was performed prior to digestion.
